999008199.text: アンチュちゃんはどんな水着が作りたい？

localizations.en: What kind of swimsuit would you like me to make, Antje?

999008199.text: ……泳げるやつ？

特に希望なしってことでいいのかな？
それにしてもさ、水着って不思議だよね

localizations.en: So no particular preference, I guess? But you know, swimsuits are kind of weird.

999008199.text:
普通の服より布が少ないのに
なぜか値段が高かったりするの！

localizations.en: They use way less fabric than regular clothes, but somehow they cost more!

999008199.text:
……普通の服より頑丈だから
素材が違って高くなるって、ミーケが言ってた

localizations.en: ...Mieke said they're more durable than regular clothes, so the materials are different and that makes them expensive.

999008199.text:
なるほどね……装飾屋が言うんだから
信頼感がある……っていうか

localizations.en: I see... If an accessory shop owner says so, it must be reliable... Wait a minute.

999008199.text:
そういえば、アンチュちゃんはミーケさんや
ディオーナさんに水着をお願いすればよかったんじゃ？

localizations.en: Come to think of it, couldn't you have asked Mieke or Diona to make you a swimsuit?

999008199.text:
ディオーナとミーケはララと同じ主催側だから
大会の内容も把握してるし……

localizations.en: Diona and Mieke are on the organizing side with Lara, so they know all about the tournament...

999008199.text:
大会に有利な水着を用意してもらっちゃったら
ズルしてるみたいだし

localizations.en: If I had them prepare a swimsuit that would give me an advantage in the tournament, it would be like cheating.

999008199.text:
変なところで生真面目なんだから。
まあ、悪い気はしないけどね

localizations.en: You're oddly principled about strange things. Well, I don't mind it though.

999008199.text:
だとしたらこっちも水着選びで手の内を見せるわけには
いかないわ。イザナ、こっちでレシピを考えるわよ

localizations.en: In that case, we can't show our hand with swimsuit selection either. Izana, let's go think up a recipe over here.

999008199.text: えっ？　ちょ、ちょっと引っ張らないでよ～！
あはは……行っちゃった
二人きりになっちゃったけど……どうする？

localizations.en: Now it's just the two of us... What do we do?

999008199.text:
いくつか水着のお店を回ってみよっか？
そうしたら理想の水着が思い浮かぶかも

localizations.en: Want to check out some swimsuit shops? Maybe you'll get an idea of your ideal swimsuit that way.

999008199.text:
うわあ、色々並んでるなあ。
えーっと、まずアンチュちゃんに合う大きさを測ろっか

localizations.en: Wow, there's so much variety here. Let me start by taking your measurements so I know what size to make.

999008199.text: ……うん、大きさ分かったよ！
測られるの、恥ずかしいんだけど

でもこれもぴったり似合う水着のためだから！
アンチュちゃんに合う大きさとなると……これとか？

localizations.en: But it's all for making you a perfectly fitting swimsuit! For your size, maybe... this one?

999008199.text: え、えぇ……それ、ほとんど、ヒモ……
わわ、ごめんなさい！？　よく見てなかった……

localizations.en: Oh no, sorry! I wasn't looking carefully...

999008199.text:
それじゃあ、こっちはどうかな？
黒いし、アンチュちゃんに似合うと思うんだ！

localizations.en: How about this one then? It's black, and I think it would look great on you!

999008199.text: ……レスナが選ぶなら、それでも

localizations.en: ...If you're choosing it, then that's fine.

999008199.text:
じゃあ、この水着を参考にして作ってみよう！　あとは
ルアッカ君たちの水着もお揃いで用意してあげようよ！

localizations.en: Alright, I'll use this swimsuit as a reference! Oh, and let's make matching ones for Ruakka and the others too!

999008199.text:
私タチハ　イツモ裸ダカラ
水着トカ　イラナイワヨ

localizations.en: We're Always Naked Anyway, So We Don't Need Swimsuits.
